checks.name: df
checks.description: disk space per mount: size, used and free bytes (POSIX df -P -k), pseudo and system mounts hidden, one row per device

checks.name: status
checks.description: os, kernel, uptime, load, memory and cpu count as key=value lines

scripts.Linux:
echo "os=$(uname -s)"; echo "kernel=$(uname -r)"; echo "arch=$(uname -m)"
awk '{print "uptime_s=" int($1)}' /proc/uptime
awk '{print "load1=" $1; print "load5=" $2; print "load15=" $3}' /proc/loadavg
awk '/^MemTotal:/{print "mem_total_kb=" $2} /^MemAvailable:/{print "mem_avail_kb=" $2}' /proc/meminfo
echo "cpus=$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || nproc)"
scripts.Darwin:
echo "os=$(uname -s)"; echo "kernel=$(uname -r)"; echo "arch=$(uname -m)"
b=$(sysctl -n kern.boottime | sed 's/^{ sec = \([0-9]*\).*/\1/'); echo "uptime_s=$(( $(date +%s) - b ))"
sysctl -n vm.loadavg | awk '{print "load1=" $2; print "load5=" $3; print "load15=" $4}'
echo "mem_total_kb=$(( $(sysctl -n hw.memsize) / 1024 ))"
vm_stat | awk '/page size of/{ps=$8} /^Pages free/{f=$3} /^Pages inactive/{i=$3} /^Pages speculative/{s=$3} END{print "mem_avail_kb=" int((f+i+s)*ps/1024)}'
echo "cpus=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)"

checks.name: os-release
checks.description: the distribution (/etc/os-release; sw_vers on macOS) as key=value lines
